input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "PUB018",
  "title": "FIFO First-In-First-Out Queue",
  "difficulty": "hard",
  "requirements": "# FIFO First-In-First-Out Queue\n\n- **Difficulty:** Hard (hard)\n\n## Requirements\n\nWrite a function block FB implementing a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) circular queue. Derive the queue capacity and element type from the caller-supplied buffer.\n\n1. Each rising edge of enqueue requests one enqueue operation. If the queue is not full, append the current item value to its tail.\n2. Each rising edge of dequeue requests one dequeue operation. If the queue is not empty, remove its front element and write that value back to item. The caller must not request enqueue and dequeue in the same invocation.\n3. When reset is TRUE, empty the queue and set elementCount to zero. Reset takes priority over enqueue and dequeue; stored buffer values need not be overwritten.\n4. Output the current number of valid elements through elementCount. Zero means the queue is empty; a count equal to the actual buffer array length means it is full.\n5. Reject a dequeue request on an empty queue or an enqueue request on a full queue. Leave the queue and item unchanged and report the reason through status.\n6. The queue is empty on its first invocation. Define head and tail positions and other internal state within the implementation; do not expose them as interface parameters.\n\nStatus codes:\n\n- 16#0000: No error in this invocation, including idle, reset and successful operations.\n- 16#8001: The dequeue request was rejected because the queue is empty.\n- 16#8002: The enqueue request was rejected because the queue is full.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `enqueue` | `BOOL` | Enqueue request; one operation per rising edge. |\n| Input | `dequeue` | `BOOL` | Dequeue request; one operation per rising edge. |\n| Input | `reset` | `BOOL` | TRUE resets the queue to empty; takes priority over enqueue and dequeue. |\n| Output | `elementCount` | `DINT` | Current number of valid elements, from zero through the queue capacity. |\n| Output | `status` | `WORD` | Invocation status: 16#0000 no error, 16#8001 dequeue from an empty queue, 16#8002 enqueue into a full queue. |\n| Input/Output | `item` | `VARIANT` | Mutable scalar reference: read its value when enqueuing; write the removed front value on successful dequeue. Its concrete type must match the array element type. |\n| Input/Output | `buffer` | `VARIANT` | Reference to a nonempty one-dimensional array with a single concrete element type, used as queue storage. Capacity is the actual array length. |\n\nAssociate buffer with a nonempty, homogeneous one-dimensional array and item with a writable scalar of the same element type. Keep the buffer association fixed for each function-block instance. Derive capacity from the actual array length; it must fit in a positive DINT.",
  "scenario": "A generic circular FIFO derives capacity/type from caller storage and handles edge requests, wraparound and rejection.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "enqueue",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Enqueue request; one operation per rising edge."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "dequeue",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Dequeue request; one operation per rising edge."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "reset",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "TRUE resets the queue to empty; takes priority over enqueue and dequeue."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "elementCount",
      "type": "DINT",
      "description": "Current number of valid elements, from zero through the queue capacity."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "status",
      "type": "WORD",
      "description": "Invocation status: 16#0000 no error, 16#8001 dequeue from an empty queue, 16#8002 enqueue into a full queue."
    },
    {
      "direction": "IN_OUT",
      "name": "item",
      "type": "VARIANT",
      "description": "Mutable scalar reference: read its value when enqueuing; write the removed front value on successful dequeue. Its concrete type must match the array element type."
    },
    {
      "direction": "IN_OUT",
      "name": "buffer",
      "type": "VARIANT",
      "description": "Reference to a nonempty one-dimensional array with a single concrete element type, used as queue storage. Capacity is the actual array length."
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "elementCount": 0,
    "status": 0,
    "head": 0,
    "tail": 0
  },
  "scan_semantics": "Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Reset empties the logical queue before handling requests.",
    "Rejected requests preserve queue and item.",
    "Only rising edges perform enqueue/dequeue."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The official VARIANT interface is preserved. Native CODESYS compatibility and runtime type/array metadata access remain unverified; never silently replace it by a DINT-only interface.",
    "Binding A: item DINT, buffer ARRAY[0..1] OF DINT. Binding B: item BOOL, buffer ARRAY[1..3] OF BOOL. Both must run to substantiate genericity.",
    "Buffer is initialized and bound once per test; its association and contents are not externally overwritten between calls. item is caller-writable every scan.",
    "Simultaneous enqueue and dequeue rising edges on a non-reset scan are outside the valid domain (rejected with ValueError); reset=TRUE takes priority over both and updates edge memories.",
    "Edge memories update during reset; a request held afterward is not another edge.",
    "Reset need not clear buffer values. Unused storage arrangement is unconstrained.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "reset": "I[k].reset: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "empty": "elementCount=0",
    "ok": "status=0",
    "pop_empty": "NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre-count=0",
    "push_full": "NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND pre-count=capacity",
    "e1": "status=16#8001",
    "e2": "status=16#8002",
    "same": "logical queue equals pre-queue AND item equals sampled item",
    "push": "NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND pre-count<capacity",
    "pushed": "post-queue=pre-queue appended with sampled item AND count=pre-count+1 AND status=0 AND item equals sampled item",
    "pop": "NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre-count>0",
    "popped": "item=pre-front AND post-queue=pre-queue without front AND count=pre-count-1 AND status=0",
    "bounded": "0<=elementCount<=actual buffer length",
    "idle": "NOT reset AND no request rising edge",
    "enqueue": "I[k].enqueue: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "dequeue": "I[k].dequeue: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "elementCount": "O[k].elementCount: independently observed post-scan candidate value (DINT); never defined as expected output.",
    "status": "O[k].status: independently observed post-scan candidate value (WORD); never defined as expected output.",
    "item": "O[k].item: independently observed post-scan candidate value (VARIANT); never defined as expected output. I[k].item denotes separately captured caller value before invocation.",
    "buffer": "O[k].buffer: independently observed post-scan candidate value (VARIANT); never defined as expected output. I[k].buffer denotes separately captured caller value before invocation.",
    "non_pop_item_preserved": "item equals sampled caller item",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.elementCount=0, O_init.status=0."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "PUB018.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB018.P1",
      "name": "Reset",
      "formula": "G(reset -> (empty & ok))",
      "explanation": "Reset overrides simultaneous requests.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB018.P2",
      "name": "Rejections",
      "formula": "G((pop_empty -> (e1 & same)) & (push_full -> (e2 & same)))",
      "explanation": "Full and empty failures preserve data.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB018.P3",
      "name": "FIFO order",
      "formula": "G((push -> pushed) & (pop -> popped))",
      "explanation": "Accepted edges update the ordered logical queue exactly once.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB018.P4",
      "name": "Count",
      "formula": "G(bounded)",
      "explanation": "Count remains within the actual caller capacity.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB018.P5",
      "name": "Held request",
      "formula": "G(idle -> (ok & same))",
      "explanation": "Held levels do not perform another operation.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB018.P6",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G((!pop) -> non_pop_item_preserved)",
      "description": "Whenever no element is successfully dequeued (idle, push, reset, or error), IN_OUT item retains the caller-provided value.",
      "explanation": "Prevents spurious overwriting of caller item when not popping.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
